title: 堪萨斯城离奇车祸 半挂车翻侧坠桥 数十牛受惊逃窜

body: Not exactly the traffic you expect to see on I-70! Angela Benton took this video of a few of the loose cows from this morning’s crash near downtown Kansas City. These cows were making their way down I-70 just past the Admiral Blvd on ramp. @kmbc https://t.co/7vuecc7Xnr — Eric Graves (@EricGravesKMBC) October 18, 2026 美国堪萨斯城（Kansas City）发生一宗离奇车祸，一辆半挂式货车在行驶期间失事坠落高速公路交汇处，其中有数十只牛逃出车外，并沿着高速公路奔跑，沿途有驾驶者拍摄牛只逃跑的情况。
